about_the_game:
This demo is intended to showcase some of the core combat mechanics.

Base Explanation:

  • In this version, the base menu only includes the map selector, as it focuses on basic combat mechanics.

  • Select the location from the map selector.

  • Once selected, in the map menu, you can choose between three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard.

Map Keys Explanation:

ESC: Open and close the options menu

Spacebar: Start wave

Q: Reveals and allows interaction with map interactive elements (while active)

W: Not implemented.

E: Restores tower durability (When active, allows you to interact with towers by hovering over their bottoms)

A: Destroys towers (When active, allows you to interact with towers by hovering over their bottoms)

1: Plant Tower (Basic Projectile)

2: Wood Tower (Sniper Projectile)

3: Rock Tower (Continuous Projectile)

4: Metal Tower (Fire Projectile)

*To cancel a skill or a tower, press the same key again.

For example, if you have Q active, pressing it again will deactivate it.

*When all skills are inactive, hovering over the tower bottoms reveals their attack range.

Mana Cycle Explanation:

  • Each tower has a mana cost.

  • Placing towers consumes mana (blue crystal on screen).

  • When defeating monsters, they release mana orbs that are absorbed by the central crystal, recharging it.

  • Standing on the crystal pedestal will recharge your mana by consuming the crystal's mana.

Explanation of the tolerance system (purple bar above the towers):

  • Each tower has a tolerance cost.

  • Placing towers reduces tolerance.

  • If the tower is destroyed, tolerance is restored.

--------------------------------------------------------

The following content is present in this demo:

Mechanics:

  • Build Towers

  • Destroy Towers

  • Repair Towers

  • Interact whit Obstacles

  • Map Waves

  • Mana Cycle

  • Tolerance Cycle

Towers:

  • Offensive Plant Tower (Single Shot)

  • Mitigation Wood Tower (Snipe Shot)

  • Defensive Stone Tower (Continuous Shot)

  • Armored Metal Tower (Fire Shot)

Map:

  • 1 Mountain Map, difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard

Enemies:

  • Basic Melee

  • Basic Ranged

  • Destroyer Melee

  • Flying Melee

The drop, crafting, and upgrade systems will be available in the next demo, as well as a new map and much more.
